brief:
Israeli occupation forces demolished a house in Khallet al-Hammus, Masafer Yatta, south of Hebron, the Ma'an news agency reported. The demolition marks the latest in a series of home destructions in the area, where Palestinian communities face ongoing displacement pressures.

Masafer Yatta, a cluster of villages in the South Hebron Hills, has long been designated a firing zone by Israeli military authorities, subjecting residents to periodic demolitions and movement restrictions.
title: Israeli bulldozers demolish home in southern Hebron
